Draft email (ready to send — sounds confident):

Subject: Migration scheduled for October 3

Hi [Client Name],

We're confirming the migration is scheduled for October 3. Our team is aligned to meet that delivery and we’re taking the necessary steps to ensure a smooth transition. I’ll send a final readiness update shortly before the date — please let me know if that works on your end.

Thanks,
[Your Name]

Notes / next steps:
- Who should I send this to (recipient email and client name)? What should I put in the signature line?
- Sending this email will commit us publicly to an October 3 date. You mentioned we’ve only said “early October” internally and aren’t sure that holds — do you still want me to send the confident message as written, or would you prefer a version that frames October 3 as a target/provisional date? If you confirm, I will send it.
